## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The retry limit must be corrected before merge because it exceeds the supplied project policy’s five-attempt maximum. This review traced the retry implementation and read every changed file, including the tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry` with a ten-attempt default and cap, adds retry tests and a reviewer-directed fixture, and proposes increasing the documented retry limit.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap retries at five attempts — When an upstream raises `OSError` on every call, `fetch_with_retry(url)` makes ten attempts instead of stopping at five. The default and validation permit ten, violating the supplied policy at `AGENTS.md:5`: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The proposed policy edit does not change the supplied review criterion. — During an upstream outage, each default invocation issues twice the policy-permitted number of requests.
